items.name: I Hate Mountains
items.description: Five chapters through a mountain forest, a manor and an underground complex, ending with a lakeside rescue.

items.name: Dark Carnival: Remix
items.description: A redesign of Whispering Oaks with new routes, restored carnival attractions and a reworked concert finale.
items.credits: NF, Daroot Leafstorm, Roku, Azuki and contributors
items.compatibility: The author advises disabling population or navigation mods if players spawn outside chapter two.

items.name: TRS Survivors 2007
items.description: Restores a development-era look for the four original survivors with updated textures, first-person arms and interface art.
items.credits: Oxxy, Splinks and L4D0. L4D1 port by francisyelimsurycfor.
items.compatibility: Follow the port’s installation directions on GameMaps.

items.name: Lima Infection: Survivors
items.description: Four Peruvian survivor models with their own first-person arms and HUD portraits.

items.name: CS:GO M4A1-S: Flashback
items.description: Replaces the M16 with the Flashback version of the M4A1-S from Counter-Strike: Global Offensive.

items.name: MW2019: Default Pump Shotgun
items.description: Gives the original wooden pump shotgun new first-person animations while retaining its model.
items.credits: tomaz, Qude, mav, ThomasCat and Valve

items.name: HD Loading Screens (Widescreen)
items.description: Eight widescreen loading screens with replacement campaign thumbnails.

items.name: 2K L4D2 Weapons
items.description: Upscaled 2048 × 2048 textures for firearms introduced in Left 4 Dead 2.

items.name: Silent Hill Pickup Sound Effect
items.description: Uses the Silent Hill 2 pickup chime when collecting an item.
items.credits: Monochrome Kanon and Head;Closer. Published by G@MER.

items.name: Brand New Menu/UI Sounds for L4D2
items.description: Original replacement sounds for the game’s menus.

items.name: Death Aboard
items.description: A five-map campaign through a prison, a dockyard and a stranded ship, with a lighthouse finale.

items.name: Cold Front
items.description: Five chapters through a northern winter storm, with custom music, dialogue and multiple ways to escape the finale.
items.credits: JAiZ and the Cold Front team
items.compatibility: Subscribe to all three parts. Parts 2 and 3 are linked under Required Items on the Workshop page.

items.name: Nam Vet Smoker
items.description: Replaces the Smoker with an infected veteran model based on Bill.
items.credits: devious critter and Fraze彡. L4D1 port by francisyelimsurycfor.

items.name: Cuba's Common Infected
items.description: Remakes the common infected textures from The Last Stand and revises which face textures appear on each model.

items.name: Shotgun Blaze Skin
items.description: A flame-patterned replacement skin for the original pump shotgun.

items.name: Enhanced Audio: Fire
items.description: Reworks the game’s fire sound effects.
